title: Anomaly ledger
description: runs/<target>/anomalies.json — target-level, NOT run-scoped, so it accumulates across runs. Things an agent noticed that were odd, inconsistent or unexplained but did not clear the bar for a reportable finding. The linear pass throws this signal away; prowler picks it back up. An entry here is explicitly NOT a finding and must never be reported as one.

id.description: Stable and unique across the whole ledger, including across runs. Convention: <module>.<short-slug>

location.description: file:line, or an operations.json id. Specific enough that a later run can find it again without re-deriving the context.

what_was_odd.description: The observation itself, stated factually. Not a hypothesis, not a severity guess — what you saw that did not fit.

why_not_reportable.description: Why it did not clear the finding bar. This is the load-bearing field: 'could not name the triggering request', 'looked deliberate but no source confirms it', 'only odd next to a sibling I did not read'. It tells prowler what work is actually outstanding.

status.description: open = never pursued. pursued = prowler worked it, inconclusive, still live. resolved_benign = understood and genuinely fine. escalated = became a candidate and entered the chain at skeptic.

recurrence.description: Other anomaly ids describing the same shape elsewhere. A pattern seen in three modules is worth more than three separate curiosities, and this is the field that makes that visible.

resolution.description: Required once status leaves 'open'. For resolved_benign this is the actual mechanism that makes the behaviour safe, with file:line — not 'looks fine'. A benign verdict with no mechanism is an unexamined anomaly wearing a resolved label.

finding_id.description: Set when status is 'escalated' — the candidate this became.

prowler_attempts.description: Times prowler has escalated this and had it come back killed. A second attempt requires naming a specific new source, so a rhetorically interesting but genuinely benign anomaly cannot consume a pursuit slot forever.

priority.description: prowler's ranking of what it did not get to, so the leftovers are ordered rather than silently dropped.
